language.name: English
gui.rmf.config.crowbar_functionality_bod: Enabling will prevent Item Crates from being able to be opened unless the player is holding a Crowbar in their offhand. It is enabled by default.
gui.rmf.config.crowbar_functionality_too: [ADMIN] Toggles the requirememnt of Crowbars to open Item Crates.
gui.rmf.config.get_all_recipes_tooltip: [DEV] Gives the user all recipes in Reg's More Foods.
gui.rmf.config.get_data_tooltip: [DEV] Gets the food and item data of the user's held item, if any can be found.
gui.rmf.config.give_item_prompt1: Enter the Item ID of the item that you wish to spawn in the box below! Item IDs can be found on the wiki, and the "rmf" prefix should be omitted.
gui.rmf.config.give_item_prompt2: Then, put the player you wish to give the item to in the second box. Or, put a target selector.
gui.rmf.config.give_item_prompt3: Then, select how many of the item to give.
gui.rmf.config.give_item_tooltip: [ADMIN] Allows the user to summon specific Reg's More Foods items.
gui.rmf.config.reset_scores_tooltip: [DEV] Resets important Reg's More Foods scoreboard variables from all players online. Please only use if something has broken!
gui.rmf.config.summon_all_items_tooltip: [ADMIN] Summons a single chest with every item in Reg's More Foods on the user's position. Stand somewhere empty!
gui.rmf.config.take_all_recipes_tooltip: [DEV] Takes all recipes in Reg's More Foods from the user.
gui.rmf.config.time_tracking_body: Enabling will allow Clocks to display daytime in 12 Hour Format ([12:00 PM]) if the player is holding one in either hand and crouching. It is enabled by default.
gui.rmf.config.time_tracking_tooltip: [ADMIN] Toggles the usage of Clocks tracking daytime in 12 hour format.
gui.rmf.config.uninstall_body: Doing so will disable the datapack, its advancements, recipes, and all custom functions it uses. Most foods added will continue to function however.
gui.rmf.config.uninstall_prompt: Are you sure you want to uninstall Reg's More Foods?
gui.rmf.config.uninstall_tooltip: [ADMIN] Safely uninstalls the datapack so it can be removed from the datapack folder without (most) issue. Use with caution!
gui.rmf.cookbook_baking_pan:
The Baking Pan is an alternative version of the Frying Pan, used for Baking recipes. Some recipes can be cooked using either tool.
It also doubles as a weapon, dealing burning damage to mobs at the cost of durability.
gui.rmf.cookbook_banana: Can be found in Acacia Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_berry_bowl: Any Berry can be used to craft this item.
gui.rmf.cookbook_biomash: The result of mashing up Biomass. Only useful for composting.
gui.rmf.cookbook_biomass:
A compacted ball of organic materal. Useful as furnace fuel, but doesn't burn for long.
Can be crafted from various items.
gui.rmf.cookbook_blackberry: Can be found from Short Grass in Snowy Biomes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_blazing_stew:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Resistance II (0:20), Hunger II (0:20), Fire Resistance (0:30)
gui.rmf.cookbook_blueberry: Can be found from Short Grass in Taiga Biomes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_brownie: Applies Speed I for 0:05 (60% chance) when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_burned_marshmallow: To roast (burn), hold a Marshmallow on a Stick over a Soul Campfire block for a few seconds.
gui.rmf.cookbook_cake_slice: Applies Speed I for 0:05 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_cat_food:
A unique item meant for Tamed Cats. Doesn't do anything special, but acts like food for them!
Can be eaten in a pinch, but has a 30% chance to cause food poisoning.
gui.rmf.cookbook_chef_apron:
Can be crafted from any color wool.
A good chef has an Apron on to avoid staining their clothes!
gui.rmf.cookbook_chef_hat:
Can be crafted from any color wool.
What cook doesn't have a Chef's Hat on?
gui.rmf.cookbook_chicken_soup: Applies Regeneration I for 0:10 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_chocolate_cupcake:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Speed I (0:10), Haste I (0:05, 60% chance)
gui.rmf.cookbook_chocolate_milk:
Clears all negative effects when consumed.
Negative effects typically come from hostile mobs, like Cave Spiders and Shulkers.
gui.rmf.cookbook_cleaver: A chef's best friend, Cleavers have natural Looting on them to provide bonus drops from mobs.
gui.rmf.cookbook_coconut: Can be found in Jungle Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_coffee: Applies Resistance II for 2:00 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_coffee_beans: Can be found from Short Grass in Jungle Biomes, or in Jungle Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_coffee_grounds: Used to make Bottles of Coffee.
gui.rmf.cookbook_cooking_pot: Currently a decorational item. Place it in an Item Frame to display it!
gui.rmf.cookbook_corn: Can be found from Tall Grass in biomes with Strawberries.
gui.rmf.cookbook_cottage_cheese: Used as a substitute for Cheese.
gui.rmf.cookbook_crowbar:
A unique tool that is required for opening Item Crates, and useful for opening the heads of hostile mobs. Hold it in your offhand when opening an Item Crate to pry them open.
Also functions as a way of "opening" Iron Doors, Bars, and Trapdoors.
gui.rmf.cookbook_curry:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Resistance I (0:20), Hunger I (0:20)
gui.rmf.cookbook_cutting_board:
A board designed for... cutting.
Hold a cuttable item in the offhand while using it to slice it up.
Typically, foods that can be cut with a Stonecutter can be cut with a Cutting Board (excluding blocks).
gui.rmf.cookbook_diamond_apple:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Regeneration (0:05), Resistance I (2:00)
gui.rmf.cookbook_diamond_shears: "What if Wooden Shears had over 1000 durability?"
gui.rmf.cookbook_dog_food:
A unique item meant for Tamed Wolves. Doesn't do anything special, but acts like food for them!
Players, however, will not like the taste.
gui.rmf.cookbook_dough: Used in various recipes. Can be smelted or baked into Bread.
gui.rmf.cookbook_dragon_fruit_pie: Applies Resistance II for 1:00 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_dragon_fruit_smoothie:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Speed I (1:00), Resistance I (0:30)
gui.rmf.cookbook_dragon_pie_mix: Used for baking Dragon Fruit Pie.
gui.rmf.cookbook_emerald_apple:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Regeneration (0:05), Luck I (2:00)
gui.rmf.cookbook_enchanted_diamond_apple:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Regeneration III (0:20), Resistance III (2:30), Absorption X (2:00), Fire Resistance (5:00)
gui.rmf.cookbook_enchanted_emerald_apple:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Regeneration III (0:20), Resistance II (2:30), Absorption III (2:00), Fire Resistance (5:00), Hero of the Village (1:00), Luck V (2:00)
gui.rmf.cookbook_enchanted_golden_apple_:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Regeneration II (0:20), Resistance I (5:00), Absorption V (2:00), Fire Resistance (5:00), Speed V (2:00)
gui.rmf.cookbook_fried_dragon_egg:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Health Boost V (5:00), Resistance IV (5:00), Absorption V (1:00)
gui.rmf.cookbook_frosted_pumpkin_pie: Applies Speed I for 0:30 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_frying_pan:
A basic tool on paper, but allows for the cooking of most foods basically anywhere.
To use, hold a fryable food in the offhand while using the Frying Pan to cook it. Requires a heat source block to be in front of the player while using (such as a Campfire, Furnace, Magma Block, etc).
Works quite effectively as a weapon, as one might imagine.
gui.rmf.cookbook_glazed_donut:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Speed I (0:10, 60% chance), Haste I (0:05, 60% chance)
gui.rmf.cookbook_golden_apple_juice:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Regeneration II (0:05), Absorption II (2:00), Speed I (1:00)
gui.rmf.cookbook_ham: Occasionally dropped from slain Adult Hoglins. Works as a decent weapon if caught in a pinch.
gui.rmf.cookbook_herbs: Used for crafting Assorted Seasoning. Can be crafted from a variety of flowers.
gui.rmf.cookbook_honey_ball:
Applies Absorption II for 1:00 when consumed.
Can be used in place of Slimeballs for crafting recipes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_honeyed_apple:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Absorption I (1:00), Speed I (0:30, 40% chance)
gui.rmf.cookbook_honeybun: Applies Absorption I for 0:30 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_hot_cocoa: Applies Speed I for 2:00 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_iced_tea:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Haste I (2:00), Fire Resistance (1:30)
gui.rmf.cookbook_incinerated_marshmallow:
To roast (reduce to charcoal), hold a Marshmallow on a Stick over a Magma Block for a few seconds.
Better used as Furnace fuel than actually eaten...
gui.rmf.cookbook_item_crate:
A storage crate that can store one type of a variety of ingredients at a time.
To use, hold at least 9 of a valid item in the offhand while using the Item Crate to store it.
gui.rmf.cookbook_juicer:
Used to create Juices from various fruits.
While having at least 1 Glass Bottle in your inventory, hold a valid fruit in the offhand while using the Juicer to squeeze it into juice.
gui.rmf.cookbook_lemon:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Absorption I (0:15), Nausea I (0:05, 40% chance)
gui.rmf.cookbook_lemon2: Can be found in Birch Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_lemon_juice:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Absorption II (0:30), Nausea I (0:07, 70% chance)
gui.rmf.cookbook_lousy_shirt:
Supposedly, there exists an ultra rare armor piece gifted by The Great Chef to those who can prove themselves worthy of equipping it.
What exactly this item does, one can only guess... but they say it afflicts shame upon anyone who doesn't own it.
gui.rmf.cookbook_mango: Can be found in Mangrove Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_marshmallow_stick:
Used for making Roasted Marshmallows.
To roast one, continously use a Marshmallow on a Stick while standing in front of a Campfire block.
gui.rmf.cookbook_mashes: Mashed items are obtained by grinding up specific fruits and/or ingredients with a Mortar & Pestle. Above is an example recipe.
gui.rmf.cookbook_menu:
Menus are helpful for displaying what a restaurant may be serving. Very fancy!
Has no actual gameplay functionality.
gui.rmf.cookbook_milk: Used as a substitute for Milk. Clears all effects when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_milk_chocolate: Applies Speed I for 0:05 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_mixing_bowl:
A crafting bowl that can create a variety of foods by utilizing Sequenced Crafting.
To mix something, hold a valid item in the offhand while using the Mixing Bowl to place it inside. Once a recipe is successfully created, an item will be created.
The bowl can be manually emptied by using it while crouching.
gui.rmf.cookbook_monster_mash: Unless you plan on rapidly starving to death, it is advised you do not eat this.
gui.rmf.cookbook_mortar_and_pestle:
Used to grind up items. Comes in several decorational variants!
To grind items, hold a valid item in the offhand and use the Mortar & Pestle.
gui.rmf.cookbook_nether_wart_soup: Applies Regeneration I for 1:00 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_ominous_cookie: Will instantly teleport the player 1-250 blocks away when consumed. Don't get lost!
gui.rmf.cookbook_orange:
Can be found in Oak Trees, alongside Apples.
Oranges and Orange Juice clear Poison when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_pale_apple: Can be found in Pale Oak Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_pale_berries: Applies Poison I for 0:05 (10% chance) when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_pale_berries2: Can be found in Short Grass in Pale Garden Biomes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_peach: Can be found in Cherry Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_peanut: Can be found in Bushes, pretty much anywhere.
gui.rmf.cookbook_pie_crust: Used for crafting special Pie foods.
gui.rmf.cookbook_powder_snow_slab:
A slab of Powdered Snow, compacted back into snow.
Used as a substitute for Powder Snow Buckets.
gui.rmf.cookbook_prickly_pear: Obtained from breaking Cactus with a Cleaver, or from using Cactus in a Stonecutter.
gui.rmf.cookbook_punnet:
Used for obtaining new fruits and berries from various blocks.
Place in the offhand while breaking forageable blocks (such as Leaves) with an empty hand to gather items.
gui.rmf.cookbook_raspberry: Can be found in Short Grass in Savanna Biomes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_rice: Used in various recipes. Can occasionally be found by Sniffers when digging.
gui.rmf.cookbook_roasted_marshmallow: To roast, hold a Marshmallow on a Stick over a (normal!) Campfire block for a few seconds.
gui.rmf.cookbook_rotten_tomato:
Rarely dropped from Tomato Crops, but can be crafted. Useful for showing ones opinion on a bad joke.
Coincidentally, Blazes have terrible senses of humor.
gui.rmf.cookbook_salmonella: Applies Hunger I for 0:30 (30% chance) when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_shaker_cup:
Used for creating new drinks and some foods by utilizing Sequenced Crafting.
To use, hold a valid item in the offhand while using the Shaker Cup to add it. Once a recipe is successfully created, use the Shaker Cup again to "shake" it into a finished product.
The cup can be manually emptied by using it while crouching.
gui.rmf.cookbook_snow_cones: Applies Speed I for 1:00 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_snow_cones2:
All Snow Cones are crafted the same way, but with different dyes.
There are 11 available colors to pick from, excluding Gray and Light Gray.
gui.rmf.cookbook_spicy_mushroom_stew:
Applies the following effects when consumed:
Resistance II (0:20), Hunger II (0:20)
gui.rmf.cookbook_straw_hat: The best way to keep cool on the farm is to be stylish while doing it!
gui.rmf.cookbook_strawberry: Can be found in Short Grass in Plains Biomes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_taiga_beans: Can be found from Short Grass in Non-Snowy Taiga Biomes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_taiga_flour: Used as a substitute for Wheat Flour.
gui.rmf.cookbook_tea: Applies Haste II for 2:00 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_tofu: Used for as a substitute for meat in various recipes.
gui.rmf.cookbook_tomato: Can be obtained from Tomato Crops.
gui.rmf.cookbook_tomato_seeds: Obtained from Tomato Crops, but can rarely be found from Short Grass while foraging.
gui.rmf.cookbook_uncooked_glow_berry_jam: Used for cooking Glow Berry Jam.
gui.rmf.cookbook_uncooked_sweet_berry_ja: Used for cooking Sweet Berry Jam.
gui.rmf.cookbook_unlimited_bacon:
According to legend, there is a mythical piece of food which always regenerates itself when eaten. 
However, it is owned by The Great Chef, who will only grant this item to those who can claim the title of being a true Gourmand...
gui.rmf.cookbook_vibrant_apple: Can be found in Dark Oak Trees.
gui.rmf.cookbook_white_chocolate: Applies Speed I for 0:10 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_wild_carrot:
Can rarely be found from Short Grass in most biomes. 
Used as a substitute for Carrots, or planted to grow more.
gui.rmf.cookbook_wild_potato:
Can rarely be found from Short Grass in most biomes. 
Used as a substitute for Potatoes, or planted to grow more.
gui.rmf.cookbook_wooden_shears:
Instantly breaks leaf blocks, but doesn't drop them like regular Shears do.
Useful when combined with a Punnet.
gui.rmf.cookbook_yogurt: Applies Health Boost I for 2:00 when consumed.
gui.rmf.cookbook_zombie_jerky: Applies Hunger I for 0:15 (20% chance) when consumed.
gui.rmf.links_body: Like Reg's More Foods? Here are some links you should check out!
gui.rmf.links_donate_body:
If you like Reg's More Foods and want to support me (regfunkid), consider one of the links below.

This is COMPLETELY OPTIONAL! I create these projects for free, because I love Minecraft!
gui.rmf.links_socials_body: If you want to hear more from me, follow me on social media!

chat.rmf.welcome_message: Reg's More Foods is now enabled on this world. To get started, craft a Book & Quill and cook it into a Gourmand's Digest Cookbook! Have fun!
advancement.rmf.a_balanced_breakfast.des:
Between 6AM-11AM, consume:
- a Bowl of Cereal, Pancake, Waffle, a Bowl of Oatmeal, or a Bowl of Scrambled Eggs
- any bottled drink or milk,
- and either a Croissant, any (non golden) Apple, an Orange, any Fried Egg, French Toast, Cooked Bacon, any Boiled Egg, Corn on the Cob, or a Banana

While wearing a Cooking Pot, hold a Mace in your mainhand and a Wind Charge in your offhand.

Last one alive, LOCK the door!

Drink every beverage added by Reg's More Foods.
